# Binary Protocol Slice Wire
> Last Sync: 2026-10-29T11:38:14.794052+00:00 UTC
> Optimization: Deterministic byte/bit offset slices and discriminant mappings for binary network protocols.
> Slashes 20,000 to 200,000 tokens of RFC manuals to compact 300-token field slices.

## Supported Protocol Slices
### Domain Name System (DNS) Header (`dns`)
- Reference: RFC 1035 | Header Length: `12 bytes` | Fields: `6`
- Schema: `v1/protocols/dns/schema.json`
- State Machine: `v1/protocols/dns/state-machine.json`
### MQTT Fixed Header (`mqtt`)
- Reference: OASIS MQTT v3.1.1 / v5.0 | Header Length: `2 bytes` | Fields: `3`
- Schema: `v1/protocols/mqtt/schema.json`
- State Machine: `v1/protocols/mqtt/state-machine.json`
### TLS Record Layer Outer Envelope (`tls_record`)
- Reference: RFC 5246 / RFC 8446 | Header Length: `5 bytes` | Fields: `3`
- Schema: `v1/protocols/tls_record/schema.json`
- State Machine: `v1/protocols/tls_record/state-machine.json`
### Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) (`dhcp`)
- Reference: RFC 2131 | Header Length: `240 bytes` | Fields: `3`
- Schema: `v1/protocols/dhcp/schema.json`
- State Machine: `v1/protocols/dhcp/state-machine.json`

## Quick Magic Signature Lookups
- `0x160301` -> **tls_record** (TLS_HANDSHAKE_CLIENT_HELLO) [HIGH]
- `0x160303` -> **tls_record** (TLS_RECORD_STANDARD) [HIGH]
- `0x170303` -> **tls_record** (TLS_APPLICATION_DATA) [HIGH]
- `0x10` -> **mqtt** (MQTT_CONNECT) [MEDIUM]
- `0xc0` -> **mqtt** (MQTT_PINGREQ) [HIGH]
